map.💡 绝干纤维量 = 湿浆质量 × 绝干率；质量浓度 = 绝干量 ÷ 浆料质量；体: 💡 Dry fibre amount = wet pulp mass × dryness; mass consistency = dry amount ÷ pulp mass; volumetric consistency = dry amount ÷ volume (g/L); dilution/thickening water = dry amount ÷ target consistency - wet pulp mass.
map.质量浓度（绝干率）以质量分数计；体积浓度需提供浆料体积: Mass consistency (dryness) is expressed as a mass fraction; volumetric consistency requires the pulp volume

map.打浆与配浆工段，需由绝干率(%)和体积(L)核算体积浓度(g/L)，控制上网浓度: In the beating and blending section, the volumetric consistency (g/L) must be computed from the dryness (%) and volume (L) to control the consistency at the machine head.
map.储浆池稀释/浓缩时，按目标绝干率反算需加水量或蒸发量。: When diluting or thickening in the storage tank, back-calculate the water to add or the amount to evaporate from the target dryness.
map.质量浓度与体积浓度混用时，统一以绝干纤维量(kg)为桥梁避免出错。: When mass consistency and volumetric consistency are mixed up, use the dry fibre amount (kg) as the bridge to avoid errors.

map.质量浓度(%)和体积浓度(g/L)有何区别？: What is the difference between mass consistency (%) and volumetric consistency (g/L)?
map.质量浓度=绝干纤维÷浆料总质量（%），体积浓度=绝干纤维÷浆料体积（g/L）。同: Mass consistency = dry fibre ÷ total pulp mass (%), volumetric consistency = dry fibre ÷ pulp volume (g/L). For the same dry amount, volume changes caused by beating degree or temperature make the two values diverge, so blending should follow whichever one the process standard specifies.
map.低浓、中浓、高浓怎么划分？: How are low, medium and high consistency divided?
